name: HIGH_RISK_FACTOR_THRESHOLD
meaning: Facility or lane is under severe compound risk (high disruption probability + high vulnerability)
consequence: Triggers HIGH_RISK alert, activates Tier 2 / Tier 3 governance escalation, blocks automated autonomous execution without human approval

name: MEDIUM_RISK_FACTOR_THRESHOLD
meaning: Moderate risk exposure requiring proactive monitoring and contingency evaluation
consequence: Generates medium priority insight, recommends contingency scenario modeling

name: DC_CAPACITY_STRESS_THRESHOLD
meaning: DC throughput is approaching maximum physical handling capacity, risk of queueing and delays
consequence: Triggers Capacity Stress Insight, recommends volume offloading or secondary DC rerouting

name: DC_CAPACITY_BOTTLENECK_CRITICAL
meaning: Severe facility bottleneck, immediate overflow and SLA failure imminent
consequence: Triggers Critical Bottleneck Action, recommends emergency rebalancing

name: MATERIAL_FORECAST_SURGE_THRESHOLD
meaning: Significant demand surge detected from telemetry or external signals
consequence: Triggers automated network re-planning workflow and MILP capacity check

name: MIN_NETWORK_FILL_RATE_TARGET
consequence: Optimization flags service degradation, triggers penalty escalation

name: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES
meaning: Specialist capability or external API experiencing persistent crashes/timeouts
consequence: Trips Circuit Breaker from CLOSED to OPEN, routes subsequent calls to fallback engine

name: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_TIMEOUT
meaning: Cooldown period expired, trial probe allowed to test recovery
consequence: Transitions Circuit Breaker from OPEN to HALF_OPEN

name: GOVERNANCE_TIER_3_FINANCIAL_THRESHOLD
meaning: Major strategic decision involving high capital expenditure or network restructuring
consequence: Classifies decision as Tier 3: Requires C-Suite / Director level approval with 2FA MFA confirmation

name: GOVERNANCE_TIER_2_FINANCIAL_THRESHOLD
meaning: Operational rerouting or spot procurement decision with material cost variance
consequence: Classifies decision as Tier 2: Requires Supply Chain Operations Lead human-in-the-loop sign-off

name: GOVERNANCE_TIER_1_AUTONOMOUS_CEILING
consequence: Classifies decision as Tier 1: Autonomous execution permitted with audit logging

name: CUSUM_DRIFT_ALLOWANCE_K
meaning: Minimum detectable persistent mean shift in demand time series

name: CUSUM_DECISION_INTERVAL_H
meaning: Statistically significant structural break identified (Type I error rate < 1%)
consequence: Declares structural break, truncates historical fitting window, triggers model re-selection
